thread:
Nina Patel: Observed quick tenant cross-show in quota + limits panel when switching orgs fast (2-3x rapid toggles). Screenshot attached. Repro on prod-live.
Ravi Shah: saw a spike in `console.panel.cache.evictions` around the time. Could be shared in-memory LRU serving stale entries to the wrong session.
Jo Park: hmm we've got a global in-process cache for rendered panels to avoid regen. It keys by route+query but not by tenant id. That sounds like the issue.
Linus Berg: strong possibility. Code snippet from memory-cache.ts: 
```ts
const key = `${route}:${serialize(query)}`;
return globalCache.get(key);
```
No tenant in key. Oops.
Nina Patel: heartbreaking but good find. This explains why a quota bar from Org-X briefly showed in Org-Y slot. Non-PII but still major isolation bug.
Ravi Shah: deployment history: console release 1.12.0 rolled at 2026-03-20T09:10UTC with new panel caching. Canary 5% then 50%. Need to correlate canary traffic vs reports.
Jo Park: two paths forward:
- quick patch: include tenant id from request context in cache key and disable global cache for 1 hour during rollout
- more robust: move to tenant-scoped caches or use request-scoped cache map keyed by tenant, and write unit tests + canary harness.
Linus Berg: prefer tenant-scoped map. Quick patch may leave edge cases where tenant id is missing (legacy clients). We should defensive-check: fall back to no-cache if tenant missing.
Nina Patel: also need an incident ticket for product/support. It's visible in dashboards, slack reports from PM. I'll file INC-2210 and update on customer-facing comms.
infra-bot: console.release 1.12.0 deployed to canary at 2026-03-20T09:10:33Z by ci/cd.
sre-alerts: alert: grafana panel "console_quota_panel_mismatch" fired (threshold > 3 mismatches/min) at 2026-03-20T09:11:07Z.
Ravi Shah: proposed hotfix: PR that amends cache key to `
const key = `${tenantId || 'anon'}:${route}:${serialize(query)}`;
` with unit tests + a smoke that flips tenant 200x in canary harness. Push to staging, then canary patch.
Jo Park: agreed but also add telemetry metric `console.cache.tenant_missing` so we can catch missing tenant header cases.
Linus Berg: caution: adding tenant to key will increase cache cardinality significantly. We should run a quick cost check: memory usage per entry * active tenants in canary. If > 2x current mem, prefer per-tenant eviction policies.
Nina Patel: action items:
- Jo Park: PR for tenant-key + tests (owner)
- Ravi Shah: run load + mem projection for canary with tenant-key (owner)
- Nina Patel: INC-2210 + customer comms draft (owner)
- Linus Berg: design doc for tenant-scoped caching (owner)
Jo Park: I'll add a canary harness job that performs rapid org-switch with asserts on rendered owner/limits text. Also adding unit test for `buildCacheKey` with tenant id present/absent.
Ravi Shah: I'll instrument Grafana to show top tenants by cache hit rate and memory footprint. If hotfix causes mem blowout, revert to disabling global cache and iterate.
Nina Patel: timeline: hotfix PR in 1h, staging verification 2h, canary patch if green. If mem > threshold we fallback to disabling global cache and rollback.
Linus Berg: FYI security: even though it's quota data, SOC flagged tenant isolation as severity P2. Keep audit trails.
Jo Park: PR: https://git.redwood/console/pulls/789 (draft) 
infra-bot: staging deploy started at 2026-03-20T09:25:11Z for console/1.12.1-hotfix.
Nina Patel: Thanks all. After we close INC-2210 let's do a short blameless postmortem and add a lint check to fail builds when `globalCache` is used without tenant context. :+1:
Ravi Shah: noted, I'll add the lint rule.
Nina Patel: tagging this for postmortem and follow-up on rollouts UX (maybe slower ramp or automated tenant-rotation tests).
